subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: May a successful lineage promotion evaluation authorize production totals, or should this stack remain shadow-only until a later explicit rollout change?
rationale: The code can enforce an authorization boundary, but tests cannot determine the intended product policy for changing authoritative historical token accounting.

options.title: Keep Shadow-Only
options.body: Land the conservative analysis machinery while keeping legacy permanently authoritative until a separate rollout decision.

options.title: Allow Gated Promotion
options.body: Accept evaluator-issued authorization as sufficient to switch authority after the missing exact-head runtime proof is added.

options.title: Pause the Stack
options.body: Hold this PR until the predecessor integration and successor validation PRs establish one complete landing unit.

recommendation.title: Keep Shadow-Only
recommendation.body: Land the conservative analysis machinery while keeping legacy permanently authoritative until a separate rollout decision.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available owner for the product-policy choice about authoritative accounting rollout.
